race.comment: LORD ARCADIA (5) looks primed for a strong showing on resumption after showing glimpses of his talent in his last campaign. He was better as he got out over further, but Pike sticks from the recent trial and the figures in his last campaign stack right up. Can land the knockout blow. LORD MOMO (2) hasn't been far away in his recent efforts, missing by 2.1L at this track and trip. Fiore remains on board and the wide draw isn't an issue with his racing pattern. Makes plenty of appeal coming back to maiden company. BATISTA (3) gets Faithfull on board today after closing nicely at this track and trip last time out. Back to a maiden is a big tick for him as he's been racing in better company for a while. Can put his best foot forward. COBAR SKY (6) can improve out in trip today. PRINCE OF BONDI (1) can go one better this time around without surprising.
